# SmartHelping

> > SmartHelping provides user-friendly, industry-specific financial model templates in Excel and Google Sheets, created by Jason Varner to simplify financial planning for businesses of all sizes.

SmartHelping offers a comprehensive library of financial modeling templates spanning real estate, SaaS, renewable energy, lending, and other industries. The platform combines ready-to-use templates with custom modeling services, helping entrepreneurs and finance professionals build accurate financial projections and valuations.

## Core Products & Templates

- [Financial Model Templates](http://www.smarthelping.com/p/excel.html): Main product page featuring Excel templates and bundle offerings
- [The Super Smart Bundle](https://www.smarthelping.com/p/the-super-smart-bundle-financial-model.html): Comprehensive bundle with all available financial model resources
- [SaaS / Subscription / Membership Financial Model Templates](https://www.smarthelping.com/p/as-service-business-models.html): SaaS and subscription business financial model templates
- [Real Estate Financial Models](https://www.smarthelping.com/p/real-estate.html): Real estate waterfall models for acquisitions and joint ventures
- [Industry-Specific Financial Models](https://www.smarthelping.com/p/industries.html): Industry-specific financial models for cash flow forecasting
- [Joint Venture Waterfall Templates](https://www.smarthelping.com/p/joint-venture.html): Joint venture waterfall templates with preferred returns
- [Valuation and DCF Analysis Spreadsheets](https://www.smarthelping.com/p/valuation-spreadsheets.html): Business valuation and DCF analysis spreadsheet templates
